combined_text.text:
Craving a comforting dish perfect for chilly days? 🥔🍲 Try this delicious loaded potato soup that's sure to warm you up! Here's how to make it step-by-step:

Start by chopping 1 pound of bacon and cooking it until crispy. While the bacon cooks, cube about 10 red potatoes and soak them in cold water. When your bacon is ready, remove it from the pot and set it aside. Using the same pot, sauté one chopped red onion and one stalk of celery until they're soft and fragrant. Next, add some minced garlic and green onions for extra flavor. To thicken the soup, stir in about 3 tablespoons of flour. 

For a smoky, Cajun twist, add 1 pound of tasso (smoked Cajun ham) – this step is optional but highly recommended for depth of flavor. Pour in 32 ounces of chicken broth and 16 ounces of heavy whipping cream. Add in your cubed potatoes along with 1 tablespoon of chicken base and your choice of spices. Let the soup simmer until the potatoes are tender.

For the cheesy goodness, shred 1 pound of extra sharp cheddar cheese. Stir half of the cheese into the soup, and reserve the other half for garnish. This whole process takes about an hour and a half, but the rich, creamy, and savory result is totally worth it! Finish by topping the soup with crispy bacon, shredded cheddar, and fresh chives. 

This loaded potato soup is a perfect hearty meal for fall and soup season. Enjoy every bite! 🍁🔥

This loaded potato soup is a perfect hearty meal for fall and soup season. Enjoy every bite! 🍁🔥
